answer_index: https://svatantrya.net/a/index.json (one static page per form: /a/<slug>/ = finished answer)

practice.role: practice.svatantrya.net - wheels, certificates and per-learner drills. Reads are open; writes need a scoped anonymous learner token from compose__learner_start (no account, no email). The shared owner is never reachable from this host.

capabilities.note: verified English counts works whose reader bundle passes; previews are UNREVIEWED; catalogue is not text.

harness: https://svatantrya.net/data/wheels/harness.json (one-fetch learning harness: wheels + decision tree + verify index + tutor/trika links)
note: Counts derive from data/traces/index.json. COMPLETE means links present, never approval.
preview_index: https://svatantrya.net/data/preview/index.json (UNREVIEWED machine previews where verified English is withheld; gates unchanged)
readability: https://svatantrya.net/data/readability.json (catalogue vs retrievable text per work; quote the status line)

start_here.first_call: MCP tool readability_status (no args) -> counts + per-work status; readability_status {work} -> one work.
start_here.then_read: search_texts (semantic, gate-filtered) or search_chunks (all layers) -> passage_evidence {work, target}.
start_here.withheld_rule: Blocked text is reported, not faked; preview_read returns UNREVIEWED machine English with its rights caveat.

tutor_levels: https://svatantrya.net/data/wheels/tutor/level-01-bases.md ... level-06-karaka.md (one prompt file per level: goal, data URLs, closed-world rules, drills)
